title: Historical abstract loss and use-dependent robustness of a semantic novelty indicator: reproducibility materials

creators.name: Lin, Yunya
creators.affiliation: School of Information Sciences, University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign, Champaign, IL, USA

description: Research software and derived numerical outputs, now including the author preprint and supplementary materials and the 37-file complete scalar-verification package. The manuscript is not peer-reviewed or journal accepted. The package independently reconstructs 5,000 scored arms and 75 family means from saved scores. No original scientific results changed. Scoped MIT applies to named original Python code/tests; CC BY 4.0 to named author-owned numerical outputs, identifiers, documentation and preprint/supplement works. Third-party rights remain excluded. Full raw-acquisition/encoding reproduction was not performed. Focal-neighbor records, raw text, embeddings, weights and private history are excluded.
notes: The generic Other (Open) record label summarizes the mixed open licenses. Consult the archived LICENSE and individual license texts for exact scope; it is not a blanket MIT or CC BY 4.0 grant.
